SELECT l.id, l.conta_pagar_id, l.conta_receber_id, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.deleted_at, l.descricao, l.tipo, l.updated_at, l.updated_by, l.valor
FROM lancamentos_caixa AS l
WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.categoria_id, p.codigo_barras, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.deleted_at, p.descricao, p.estoque_atual, p.estoque_minimo, p.ncm, p.nome, p.preco_custo, p.preco_venda, p.sku, p.unidade_medida, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
FROM produtos AS p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.estoque_atual <= 0.0 OR p.estoque_atual < p.estoque_minimo)

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM vendas AS v
WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT l.id, l.conta_pagar_id, l.conta_receber_id, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.deleted_at, l.descricao, l.tipo, l.updated_at, l.updated_by, l.valor
FROM lancamentos_caixa AS l
WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.categoria_id, p.codigo_barras, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.deleted_at, p.descricao, p.estoque_atual, p.estoque_minimo, p.ncm, p.nome, p.preco_custo, p.preco_venda, p.sku, p.unidade_medida, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
FROM produtos AS p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.estoque_atual <= 0.0 OR p.estoque_atual < p.estoque_minimo)

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM vendas AS v
WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.data_venda >= @dataInicio_Value AND v.data_venda <= @dataFim_Value

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT v.total
FROM vendas AS v
WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 2 AND v.data_venda >= @inicio AND v.data_venda < @fim

WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.fornecedor_id, c.status, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor
FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by

) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf

    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id

    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.fornecedor_id, c.status, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor
FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0

    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT m.id, m.created_at, m.created_by, m.deleted_at, m.descricao, m.documento_origem, m.motivo_codigo, m.produto_id, m.quantidade, m.quantidade_anterior, m.quantidade_resultante, m.tipo, m.updated_at, m.updated_by
    FROM movimentacoes_estoque AS m
    WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS m0
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p.id, p.categoria_id, p.codigo_barras, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.deleted_at, p.descricao, p.estoque_atual, p.estoque_minimo, p.ncm, p.nome, p.preco_custo, p.preco_venda, p.sku, p.unidade_medida, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
    FROM produtos AS p
    WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS p0 ON m0.produto_id = p0.id
ORDER BY m0.created_at DESC

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

FROM (
    SELECT m.id, m.created_at, m.created_by, m.deleted_at, m.descricao, m.documento_origem, m.motivo_codigo, m.produto_id, m.quantidade, m.quantidade_anterior, m.quantidade_resultante, m.tipo, m.updated_at, m.updated_by
    FROM movimentacoes_estoque AS m
    WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p.id, p.categoria_id, p.codigo_barras, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.deleted_at, p.descricao, p.estoque_atual, p.estoque_minimo, p.ncm, p.nome, p.preco_custo, p.preco_venda, p.sku, p.unidade_medida, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
    FROM produtos AS p
    WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS p0 ON m0.produto_id = p0.id
ORDER BY m0.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.fornecedor_id, c.status, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor
FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT p.id, p.categoria_id, p.codigo_barras, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.deleted_at, p.descricao, p.estoque_atual, p.estoque_minimo, p.ncm, p.nome, p.preco_custo, p.preco_venda, p.sku, p.unidade_medida, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
FROM produtos AS p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.estoque_atual <= 0.0 OR p.estoque_atual < p.estoque_minimo)

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.fornecedor_id, c.status, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor
FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT v0.id, v0.cliente_id, v0.created_at, v0.created_by, v0.data_venda, v0.deleted_at, v0.desconto, v0.funcionario_id, v0.numero, v0.observacao, v0.status, v0.subtotal, v0.total, v0.updated_at, v0.updated_by, c0.id, c0.cpf_cnpj, c0.created_at, c0.created_by, c0.deleted_at, c0.email, c0.nome, c0.telefone, c0.tipo_pessoa, c0.updated_at, c0.updated_by, c0.endereco_bairro, c0.endereco_cep, c0.endereco_cidade, c0.endereco_complemento, c0.endereco_logradouro, c0.endereco_numero, c0.endereco_uf, f0.id, f0.cargo, f0.cpf, f0.created_at, f0.created_by, f0.data_admissao, f0.deleted_at, f0.nome, f0.salario, f0.updated_at, f0.updated_by, f0.usuario_id
FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 3

FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 3

SELECT l.id, l.conta_pagar_id, l.conta_receber_id, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.deleted_at, l.descricao, l.tipo, l.updated_at, l.updated_by, l.valor
FROM lancamentos_caixa AS l
WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c

FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 3

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.fornecedor_id, c.status, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor
FROM contas_pagar AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status IN (1, 3) AND date_trunc('day', c.data_vencimento, 'UTC') <= @limite

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id
FROM contas_receber AS c
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 3

FROM (
    SELECT v.id, v.cliente_id, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.data_venda, v.deleted_at, v.desconto, v.funcionario_id, v.numero, v.observacao, v.status, v.subtotal, v.total, v.updated_at, v.updated_by
    FROM vendas AS v
    WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY v.data_venda DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS v0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.id, c.cpf_cnpj, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.deleted_at, c.email, c.nome, c.telefone, c.tipo_pessoa, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.endereco_bairro, c.endereco_cep, c.endereco_cidade, c.endereco_complemento, c.endereco_logradouro, c.endereco_numero, c.endereco_uf
    FROM clientes AS c
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS c0 ON v0.cliente_id = c0.id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.id, f.cargo, f.cpf, f.created_at, f.created_by, f.data_admissao, f.deleted_at, f.nome, f.salario, f.updated_at, f.updated_by, f.usuario_id
    FROM funcionarios AS f
    WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
) AS f0 ON v0.funcionario_id = f0.id
ORDER BY v0.data_venda DESC

SELECT c.id, c.cliente_id, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.data_pagamento, c.data_vencimento, c.deleted_at, c.descricao, c.forma_pagamento, c.numero_parcela, c.status, c.total_parcelas, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.valor, c.venda_id

FROM contas_receber AS c
